Before I touch it — this is a breaking change to a published contract, not just a field name.

`routes/users.js:6` is the only place `userId` appears. Renaming it to `user_id` changes what `GET /users` returns to every existing client. Per `README.md`, those are the web app, the iOS app (3.2 and later), and the nightly partner export — and it states explicitly: "Field names in the response are part of the contract; changes go through a versioned endpoint."

So the one-line edit silently breaks any client that reads `userId`, and the iOS clients in particular can't be updated in lockstep with the server.
